items.title: FNBO’s Marc Butterfield on preparing for AI agents that shop for credit cards
items.why: Plan now for AI agents as a card distribution channel, since agent shopping will decide which cards get recommended.
items.summary_ai: First National Bank of Omaha's Marc Butterfield discusses preparing card products for AI agents that shop on consumers' behalf.
items.take: Plan now for AI agents as a card distribution channel, since agent shopping will decide which cards get recommended.
